attributes.armed: Whether the one-off schedule remains armed.
attributes.cleanup_pending: Retained obligation to withdraw this trip's owned Full request.
attributes.departure: Selected departure as an aware ISO timestamp, or null if unset.
attributes.full_generation: Logical Full request generation, advanced by manual and trip handoffs.
attributes.generation: Schedule generation used to invalidate obsolete queued events and starts.
attributes.legacy_conflict: Known enabled or unreadable legacy dispatcher/arming/ownership prevents built-in arming.
attributes.owner_token: Entry-local scheduler lease token, or null; not a credential or external control identity.
attributes.owns_full: Whether the journal's token and generation still own the current logical Full request.
attributes.storage_status: Journal restore/save availability; invalid or unavailable cannot authorize a new start.
attributes.target_soc: Selected integer trip target; not a permanent EV charge limit.
